subject: Reference discovery: HealthSync customer story — scheduling & media release
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reference discovery: HealthSync customer story — scheduling & media release

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a HealthSync customer story — we really appreciate the team taking time. I wanted to get a discovery call on the calendar so we can:

- Align on the story angle and primary outcomes you want highlighted
- Confirm stakeholders who should join (product, engineering, legal, and any execs)
- Walk through a short agenda (10–15 minute customer background + 25 minute deep dive + wrap)
- Confirm media/recording permissions and next steps for legal sign-off

Proposed 45-minute slots (PDT):
- Tue 7/28 10:00–10:45
- Wed 7/29 14:00–14:45
- Thu 7/30 09:00–09:45

Attached are a draft agenda and a proposed media-release template for your legal team to review. We typically record the session (Zoom cloud) for internal note-taking and for producing the written case study. We can redact or omit any PII you flag before publication.

If any of those times work, please let us know your preferred slot and who from HealthSync will join. If you prefer we send a DocuSign for the media release, happy to do that — I can route to the right person.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Attachment: discovery_agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: media_release_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom@healthsync.ai>, Samuel Park <samuel.park@healthsync.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reference discovery: HealthSync customer story — scheduling & media release

Hi Priya — thanks for the note. We’re excited to participate.

We can do Wed 7/29 14:00–14:45 PDT. I’ll join along with Tom (Head of Product) and Sam (legal counsel) — copying them here.

A few requests from our side:
- We need the media release reviewed by legal (Sam) — happy to sign once redlines are resolved.
- We ask for PII redaction for any patient or clinician names; we’ll provide a short list before publication.
- Can you share the specific questions you plan to ask so Tom can prep usage numbers?

I’ve attached our brand assets for logo use (zip).

Elena
VP, Customer Success
HealthSync
Attachment: healthsync_logo.zip (application/zip)

> 
> Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a HealthSync customer story — we really

> can: ...

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Briggs <tom@healthsync.ai>, Samuel Park <samuel.park@healthsync.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reference discovery: HealthSync customer story — scheduling & media release

Elena — perfect, thanks for confirming Wed 7/29 14:00 PDT. I’ve sent a calendar invite (attached .ics) to the group.

Updated agenda (45 min):
- 0–10 min: Introductions + HealthSync background and outcomes you want highlighted
- 10–30 min: Technical and operational deep dive (Tom) — architecture decisions, latency/cost improvements with Redwood, and rollout notes
- 30–40 min: Results and ROI narrative (Tom/Elena) — metrics, anecdotes, quotes
- 40–45 min: Next steps, approval process, and timeline for draft review (Priya/Marissa)

Sam — thank you for joining. If you’re comfortable, we’ll send the media release via DocuSign here: https://app.docusign.com/healthsync-media-release/ABC123. You can either sign or propose redlines; if you prefer to mark them in the doc, we’ll review with our legal team and follow up.

On recording: we will record the session to Zoom cloud for note-taking and for creating the write-up. We can remove any segments with PII before the draft is shared. If you prefer local recording only, let us know and we’ll disable cloud storage.

Tom — specific prep items / questions you can expect:
- Timeline and scope of the Redwood integration (initial rollout date, phases)
- Observed latency and throughput improvements with the dedicated deployment
- Any quantifiable cost reductions or operational efficiencies
- One or two customer-facing anecdotes we can quote (we will get approval before publishing)

Please let us know if the agenda looks good or if you want to add anything.

Thanks all — calendar_invite.ics attached.

Best,
Priya
Attachment: calendar_invite.ics (text/calendar)

From: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom@healthsync.ai>, Samuel Park <samuel.park@healthsync.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reference discovery: HealthSync customer story — scheduling & media release

Thanks — we’ve reviewed the agenda and signed the DocuSign. Sam left one small note on IP language which he pasted inline in DocuSign; looks minor.

We’re happy with the recording being stored in Zoom cloud as long as you remove any clinician/patient identifiers before sharing drafts. Tom will bring numbers and a brief deck (3 slides). We’ll join via the Zoom link in the invite.

See you Wednesday.

—Elena
Attachment: (signed) media_release_signed.pdf (application/pdf)
